description: Validate the format and check digit of South Korean business registration numbers (사업자등록번호, 10 digits, NTS weights 1,3,7,1,3,7,1,3,5) and format them as 123-45-67890. This is an offline checksum test only: it does not tell whether the business is open or closed.
name: kr_business_number_check
title: Check Korean business registration numbers
